about_the_game:
Set in the secluded Mount Gen , this narrative is deeply rooted in traditional culture. Beyond delivering chilling mysteries, it immerses you in ethereal ink-wash landscapes and the transcendent artistry of ritual porcelain, revealing the philosophical legacy of ceramic heritage.

You play as Feng Cimu, a tenacious influencer unraveling both a dark conspiracy and her own shrouded past amid escalating peril.

Through this visceral journey, you will:
• Confront grotesque monsters.
• Wield esoteric artifacts and transmute your form to survive.
• Navigate human duality—where sacrifice clashes with redemption—through consequential choices.
• Shape branching narratives where every puzzle, decision, and uncovered truth alters your destiny.

Featuring multi-layered storytelling, aesthetic ink-painting visuals, and innovative exploration, this odyssey across Mount Gen will leave an indelible imprint.

How will you:
• decide your fate?
• help others get out of abyss?
• Inscribe your legend?
